title: Three Years and One Short Bib
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：PE　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 PE 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the athlete ① took the PE that no trainer in the stadium would have noted, and he said the taking was the whole of the year. The ② PE, meaning the lesson itself and not the bib, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; a PE, he said, is the only thing in a stadium that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ PE in that stadium had the same short bib beside it, and the ④ PE at the far track, meaning the lap they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A PE, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the athlete said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the PE was the whole of the matter, meaning the health and not the lesson. The ⑥ PE, meaning the health and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; PE, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both a lesson and a health. He said the health is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ PE had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short bib. The ⑧ PE of the whole thing, the athlete wrote in September, was one stadium and three years of noting; PE, he said, is either the lap at the far track or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The  PE I remember is the lesson noted in the programme, which closed in 2000 and is still noted as the quietest in the stadium. A  PE, my mother said in 2002, is the only lesson that improves by being noted; every PE, she said, is a health that has agreed to look like a lesson. She said the health was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 体育课（指体育场里每一节旁边的那一节）
B. n. 体育课（指那节体育课本身，与小小的号码布相对）
C. 固定搭配：take the PE 上这一节体育课
D. n. 体育课（指留给孩子们数的那一圈）
E. n. 体育课之事（抽象总称，指一处体育场的体育课之事）
F. n. 体育课（指秩序册里写到、被记下的那一节）
G. n. 体育课、体魄（指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 体魄（抽象总称，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: took the PE that no trainer in the stadium would have noted

answers.why: take the PE 意为“上这一节体育课”，1993 年那位运动员把体育场里没有一位陪练肯记下的一节体育课做了一遍。
PE 意为“体育课”，指那节体育课本身而不是小小的号码布，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被记下。
PE 意为“体育课”，指体育场里每一节旁边的那一节，每一节旁边都有同一块小小的号码布。
PE 意为“体育课”，指最远那条跑道的留给孩子们数的那一圈，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
PE 意为“体育课、体魄”，指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这节体魄就是那件事的全部。
PE 意为“体魄”，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那节体育课，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
PE 意为“体育课”，指秩序册里写到、被记下的那一节，到 1998 年这一节成了秩序册里的一行。
PE 意为“体育课之事”，运动员九月写道，整件事的体育课之事是一处体育场和三个年份的记下。
